entry.author: New Zealand Trade and Enterprise
entry.summary:
If you're a New Zealand exporter thinking of entering the European market, it's important to get your business ready. European market expert, B2B sales specialist and NZTE Beachhead advisor Geert Van der Elst explains 3 ways to prepare your business, so you can make the most of the massive opportunity available in Europe.

https://my.nzte.govt.nz/article/20251013-get-insights-from-expert-global-business-advisors
